description: A React component implementing a user interface for uploading documents, managing persona data, and orchestrating backend requests for persona generation and validation. It features document upload UI, draft regeneration, state management, and artifact integration within a Next.js frontend.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-string entries.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials for display based on a label string.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties within an object following a specified path, returning the value and the found path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs available keys in an object for debugging orchestration payload shapes.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from an orchestration record, prioritizing certain paths and types.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the front-end PersonaData shape, supporting multiple backend formats.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for PersonaData to detect changes.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Generates a fingerprint string for persona JSON artifacts to detect changes.
